values: Use fictional information to practise preparing employee, schedule and holiday data for the HMF portal.
Matches the CSV columns currently accepted by People > Import employees from CSV.
Helps HR plan weekly schedules. Schedules are currently entered in the portal from an employee profile or assigned from a reusable template.
Helps HR prepare allowances and balances. Only annual allowance and carried forward are currently entered on the employee profile; leave taken and booked are planned for the leave-management phase.
All names and emails in this workbook are fictional. Do not use real employee information in the demo.
The current portal accepts 1 to 50 new employees per CSV import and does not overwrite existing employees.
CSV import creates ordinary employee records only. Passwords and elevated HR or administrator access are not imported.
Complete the yellow cells, save only the Employee import worksheet as CSV UTF-8, then upload it under People > Import employees from CSV and review the preview before confirming.
